scripts.health:services: curl -fsS http://localhost:4000/health && curl -fsS http://localhost:4001/health && curl -fsS http://localhost:4002/health && curl -fsS http://localhost:4003/health
scripts.db:health: docker compose exec postgres pg_isready -U blog -d posts_db
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d posts_db
scripts.db:databases: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d postgres -c "\l"
scripts.db:tables: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d posts_db -c "\dt" && docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d comments_db -c "\dt" && docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d query_db -c "\dt" && docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d event_bus_db -c "\dt"
scripts.db:posts: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d posts_db -c "SELECT * FROM posts ORDER BY created_at DESC;"
scripts.db:comments: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d comments_db -c "SELECT * FROM comments ORDER BY created_at DESC;"
scripts.db:query-posts: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d query_db -c "SELECT * FROM query_posts ORDER BY created_at DESC;"
scripts.db:query-comments: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d query_db -c "SELECT * FROM query_comments ORDER BY created_at DESC;"
scripts.db:events: docker compose exec postgres psql -U blog -d event_bus_db -c "SELECT id, type, data, created_at FROM events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50;"
